name: blackboard-tasksync
description: Privacy-first local Chrome extension aggregating Blackboard deadlines into an actionable task manager with 1-click RFC 5545 iCal export.

scripts.test: node -e "require('esbuild').buildSync({ entryPoints: ['src/test/calendarExport.test.ts'], bundle: true, outfile: 'dist/test.cjs', format: 'cjs', platform: 'node' }); require('./dist/test.cjs');" && rm -f dist/test.cjs
